name: Weston
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Weston, MA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Weston, MA: the Nutcracker at Regis College, Trimming the Tavern at the Golden Ball Tavern and the Knox Park tree lighting.
lede: Weston's Christmas centers on its town center and Boston Post Road: the Weston Community League lights the tree in Knox Park, the Golden Ball Tavern dresses every room for the season, and Commonwealth Ballet brings The Nutcracker to Regis College.
celebrates: The Weston Community League lights the town tree in Knox Park on the first Sunday in December, with Santa and friends, hot chocolate, treats and live music. On Boston Post Road, the Golden Ball Tavern Museum hosts Trimming the Tavern, when the Country Garden Club of Weston and other town groups decorate every room around a theme and children follow a scavenger hunt. Commonwealth Ballet Company performs The Nutcracker at the Casey Theater at Regis College, including a sensory friendly show. The Weston Fire Department takes Santa on a ride through town, and neighbors gather to sing carols outside the Josiah Smith Tavern on Christmas Eve.
lastyear: In 2025, Trimming the Tavern ran from December 6 to 13 at the Golden Ball Tavern, with a red, white and blue theme for the nation's 250th anniversary that the museum says drew more than 500 guests. The Weston Community League lit the tree in Knox Park on December 7, and the Weston Observer reported that Santa and Mrs. Claus would visit, after an earlier stop at the Land's Sake farmstand. On December 17, Santa rode through town with the Fire Department.
facts: The Golden Ball Tavern Museum says its holiday open house collaboration with the Country Garden Club of Weston has been a tradition for almost 60 years. Commonwealth Ballet is in its 35th season, and its sensory friendly Nutcracker, first offered ten years ago, has a one hour run time and a Behind the Ballet Discovery Room. The Weston Community League is a nonprofit whose December calendar also includes Christmas caroling outside the Josiah Smith Tavern on Christmas Eve.
trains: Weston has two stops on the MBTA Fitchburg Line, Kendal Green and Silver Hill, between Brandeis/Roberts and Lincoln. Inbound trains run through Waltham, Belmont and Porter to North Station in Boston, so a holiday trip into the city does not need a car. For a train ride with a holiday theme, Edaville in Carver runs a Holiday Express through Christmas lights, and Lowell has the Boston and Maine Railroad Historical Society's steam locomotive No. 410 and the National Streetcar Museum.

faq: Where is the Weston tree lighting?

The Weston Community League holds its Holiday Tree Lighting and Live Music in Knox Park, at the corner of Boston Post Road and Town House Road across from the fire station. It takes place on the first Sunday in December from 3:45 pm, and the town calendar lists it as free, with Santa and friends, hot chocolate, treats and live music.

Yes. The Golden Ball Tavern Museum on Boston Post Road describes Trimming the Tavern as free and family friendly. Local groups led by the Country Garden Club of Weston decorate each room around a theme, and children can follow a scavenger hunt with clues in every room. The museum is open daily during the event week.
Is there a sensory friendly Nutcracker near Weston?

Yes. Commonwealth Ballet Company offers one Sensory and Family Friendly performance of The Nutcracker at the Casey Theater at Regis College. It runs about one hour, includes all of Act I and some of Act II, costs less than the regular shows, and opens with a Behind the Ballet Discovery Room for children.

Yes. The Weston Fire Department takes Santa through town on one December evening. In 2025 the Weston Observer reported stops on the north side around 6 pm, at Town Hall around 6:45 pm and on the south side around 7 pm on December 17. Check the town calendar each year for the route and timing.
Which train stations are in Weston?

Weston has two stops on the MBTA Fitchburg Line, Kendal Green and Silver Hill. Inbound trains run through Waltham, Belmont and Porter to North Station in Boston, and outbound trains continue to Lincoln, Concord and beyond. Check the MBTA weekend schedule before planning a holiday trip by train.
